stature_inflation.investigation_findings: Stage 24 fitting optimized an isotropic scale factor of 1.1763 applied to the canonical SMPL template (which already had stature 1,664 mm), expanding overall height to 1,955.5 mm. Because the subject's calves and feet were truncated by the camera frame (y > 720 px), Stage 25 Dirichlet boundary pinning locked the unobserved lower limbs to this fitted template prior, preserving the 1,955.5 mm stature.
stature_inflation.remedy: Acknowledge that stature is MODEL_DERIVED_UNOBSERVED_REGION due to physical sensor vertical truncation; do not claim physical observation of crown-to-sole height.

shoulder_breadth_discrepancy.investigation_findings: Stage 25 mapped 'acromion_left' to vertex 1378 (X=+0.268m) and 'acromion_right' to vertex 4851 (X=-0.268m). These vertices are located on the extreme lateral deltoid muscle surface, not the bony acromial process. Scaled by 1.176, this yielded 632.2 mm.
shoulder_breadth_discrepancy.remedy: Replaced with verified anatomical acromiale landmarks on the superior acromial shelf: Left acromiale (idx=1903, X=+0.198m) and Right acromiale (idx=5363, X=-0.198m), yielding a true biacromial breadth of 396.4 mm (baseline) and 466.2 mm (scaled).

waist_circumference_inflation.investigation_findings: A catastrophic landmark index typo in smpl_backend.py set 'perineum' to vertex 3171 (which is on the chin/neck at Z=+0.530m) instead of vertex 3170 (crotch floor at Y=-0.041m). Evaluating z_waist = p_per[2] + 0.40*(p_neck[2] - p_per[2]) from the chin evaluated to Z=+0.355m (the shoulder / upper arm level). Transverse slicing at Z=+0.355m intersected the chest AND both biceps, producing a combined torso+arms perimeter of 1,402.2 mm.
waist_circumference_inflation.remedy: Corrected perineum to vertex 3170. Standardized to Stage 22 ISB frame and sliced at Y = Y_per + 0.42 * Trunk_Height (omphalion level), yielding a natural waist of 972.7 mm with 92.3% physical RealSense surface observation support.

hip_circumference_inflation.investigation_findings: Similarly, evaluating z_hip = p_per[2] + 0.12*(p_neck[2] - p_per[2]) from the chin landmark (vertex 3171) evaluated to Z=+0.399m (the clavicle / lower neck level), yielding an inflated upper thoracic / shoulder loop of 1,261.4 mm.
hip_circumference_inflation.remedy: Sliced at true pelvic crest level (Y = Y_per + 0.15 * Trunk_Height), yielding 1,230.5 mm with 70.7% physical RealSense surface observation support.

torso_length_collapse.investigation_findings: Because 'perineum' was mapped to vertex 3171 on the chin (Z=+0.530m), torso length was computed as abs(p_neck[2] - p_per[2]) = abs(0.397 - 0.530) = 0.133m = 133 mm (156.2 mm scaled), measuring the neck notch to chin distance rather than the trunk height.
torso_length_collapse.remedy: Corrected perineum to vertex 3170 (crotch floor). Measured true trunk height from suprasternale notch to perineum floor: 490.2 mm on personalized mesh (514.8 mm on baseline fitted mesh).

upper_leg_length_distortion.investigation_findings: 'hip_left' and 'hip_right' were mapped to vertices 1383 and 4857 (which are located on the anterior clavicles at Y=+0.43m). Upper leg length was measured from clavicle to knee.
upper_leg_length_distortion.remedy: Mapped to verified bilateral trochanterion landmarks: Left (idx=847) and Right (idx=4333) at the superior margin of the greater trochanter.
